newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania PM Bashkim Fino to visit United States.
newsitem.headline: Albania PM Bashkim Fino to visit United States.

text.p: Albania's interim prime minister Bashkim Fino has been invited to pay an official visit to Washington, his spokesman said on Thursday.
The spokesman said the invitation came from U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright and was conveyed to Fino by U.S. ambassador to Tirana Marisa Lino.
He said the programme for the visit and its exact timing would be agreed later, but it would probably take place in the next two weeks.
The U.S. embassy in Tirana declined to comment on the statement and referred enquiries to the State Department in Washington.

Fino, a member of Albania's Socialist Party, was appointed prime minister when a nine-party National Reconciliation Government was installed on March 9 to halt the nation's slide towards anarchy following widespread unrest over the collapse of pyramid savings schemes.
The government has promised to hold fresh elections by the end of June.

Albanian President Sali Berisha visited Washington and met President Bill Clinton in September 1995. But relations with the United States deteriorated after general elections in May 1996 which international monitors said were flawed. Berisha's Democratic Party won 122 seats in the 140-seat parliament.
